text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"περὶ τοῦ οὐτιδανοῦ, πρὸς Μενεκράτην, η'.","english":"Regarding the useful to Menecrates, eight","kind":"sense","why":"The source refers to the 'outidanos' (nobody/insignificant), but the English translates it as 'useful'.","certainty":"high"},{"source":"περὶ τοῦ ὅτι διὰ τῆς ἰδίας λόγου, πρὸς Ἐπικράτην, α'.","english":"regarding the useful speech to Epicrates, one.","kind":"sense","why":"The source refers to 'the speech through one's own [reason/argument]', but the English translates it as 'useful'.","certainty":"high"},{"source":"περὶ τῶν ἀπόρων διαλεκτικῶν λόγων, πρὸς Διοσκορίδην, ε'.","english":"regarding ambiguous dialectical speeches to Dioscorides, five","kind":"sense","why":"The source refers to 'apora' (puzzles/difficulties), but the English translates it as 'ambiguous'.","certainty":"medium"},{"source":"περὶ συνηθείας, πρὸς Διονύσιον, ζ'.","english":"regarding custom to Gorgippides, seven.","kind":"sense","why":"The source names Dionysius, but the English names Gorgippides.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.source: περὶ τοῦ οὐτιδανοῦ, πρὸς Μενεκράτην, η'.
contradictions.english: Regarding the useful to Menecrates, eight
contradictions.why: The source refers to the 'outidanos' (nobody/insignificant), but the English translates it as 'useful'.

contradictions.source: περὶ τοῦ ὅτι διὰ τῆς ἰδίας λόγου, πρὸς Ἐπικράτην, α'.
contradictions.english: regarding the useful speech to Epicrates, one.
contradictions.why: The source refers to 'the speech through one's own [reason/argument]', but the English translates it as 'useful'.

contradictions.source: περὶ τῶν ἀπόρων διαλεκτικῶν λόγων, πρὸς Διοσκορίδην, ε'.
contradictions.english: regarding ambiguous dialectical speeches to Dioscorides, five
contradictions.why: The source refers to 'apora' (puzzles/difficulties), but the English translates it as 'ambiguous'.
The source names Dionysius, but the English names Gorgippides.
